name: helpdesk_sla
summary: SLA engine: policy auto-timers, business calendars, breach/escalation evaluation
description: Automatically starts first-response and resolution SLA clocks on ticket creation per matching policy, computes deadlines against business calendars and holidays, pauses clocks on pending tickets, evaluates warning/breach thresholds via a scheduled job, fires escalation rules, and keeps an append-only SLA audit trail.
author: Nexa
